description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PlayerAndBot" name="Player and farming bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DefineDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarm_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostFarm_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_NaturalDisaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SetbackApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseResources" name="Choose resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define tool and resource dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm resources using configured priorities and dependencies">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(10, numberOfSelectedResources)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback to bot"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SetbackApplied" name="Bot setback applied"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">milestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone notification sent"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarm_Split" name="Choose post-farming actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostFarm_Join" name="Post-farming actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Farming and selected actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Begin_Choose" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_ChooseResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_Priorities" sourceRef="Task_ChooseResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_Dependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_PostSplit" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_Task" sourceRef="Boundary_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_SetbackApplied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_Task" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Materials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">materialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostFarm_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
